A1.justification: Despite the changed title and framing, both PDFs describe the same guidance-decoupled diffusion framework and share substantial experimental material. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original FFHQ and AFHQv2 generation experiments, FID and controllability measurements, human preferences, and guidance ablations in Section 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains original generation evaluations and adds porcelain results, facial image editing, text-to-3D generation, and a 3D refinement ablation.

M1.justification: The guidance-decoupled backbone remains, but v2 replaces initialization from normalized null-text features with domain-prompt text features optimized through denoising loss. It also introduces norm-based guidance-weight initialization and a staged image-generation, image-to-3D, and SDS-refinement procedure (Sections 3.3–3.4 and Appendix C.3). These are substantive procedural additions beyond terminology changes.

E1.justification: v2 retains FFHQ and AFHQv2 and adds a collected 5,000-image porcelain domain, SDEdit-based facial editing, and text-to-3D porcelain generation. These substantially broaden the represented data and task requirements. The full-body face-swapping and enhancement demonstration from v1 Appendix F is removed.

E2.justification: v2 adds Fine-tuning + LoRA to the quantitative comparisons, SDXL 1.0 to the domain-alignment illustrations, and SD1.5-based DreamFusion as a 3D comparator. It removes the StyleGAN3-T reference from v1 Table 1. The Fine-tuning row and corresponding galleries match the earlier DreamBooth comparison; Appendix C.2 retains the DreamBooth description, so this relabeling is not counted as a new comparator.

E3.justification: The retained benchmarks keep their 512-resolution, 50,000-image FID, attribute-testing, and Canny-testing designs. v2 adds a 100-step embedding phase using 3,200 images, SDEdit settings of 20 steps and 0.6 noise strength, and 3D refinement guidance scales of 100 and 50. The reported method size changes from 859M to 810M parameters; this does not establish that retained experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: v2 adds a qualitative fine-tuning trajectory, a cat/dog condition-conflict case, and a 3D ablation replacing the porcelain model with basic SD. It removes v1's two-dimensional guidance-scale grid and positive/negative guidance sweeps. The unconditional-guidance rectification and flower condition-decoupling analyses are retained in relocated figures.

E5.justification: v1 Section 3.2 explicitly states that the customized-model guidance-drift examples use the same random seed; the corresponding v2 Section 3.1 and Figure 4 omit that disclosure. Matched-seed user-study procedures remain. Neither version reports repeated-run variability, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: v2 adds porcelain scores, LoRA results, editing and 3D outcomes, and resource-overhead figures. Porcelain FID is 56.46 for the proposed method versus 62.76 for Fine-tuning. Retained face/animal FIDs remain 6.57/18.82, and text/spatial alignment remains 0.89/0.20. Preference percentages change, including face preference from 89.4% to 87.5%, under an expanded comparison set. StyleGAN3 results and guidance-sweep outcomes are removed.

T1.justification: The central multi-guidance equation and its log-probability derivation are retained; v2 Property A.1 largely relocates v1 Section 4.2 rather than supplying a new proof. v2 adds norm-based weight definitions and a conditional/unconditional pretraining-objective formulation. The negative-prompt equation and probability interpretation from v1 Section 4.4 are removed.

C1.justification: The headline contribution shifts from a new concept-centric personalization task and GCFG explorations to image-only in-domain generation across multiple tasks, explicitly including 3D generation. Efficient domain learning and the application pipeline become central contributions. Negative-prompt theory and condition decoupling cease to be headline contributions, although condition decoupling remains in the appendix.

C2.justification: v2 explains hybrid outputs from conflicting conditions and recommends fuller domain-specific prompts. Appendix E introduces quantified inference costs, parallel-GPU mitigation, and possible distillation. It revises the out-of-domain limitation into domain/control guidance conflict, while dropping v1's explicit StyleGAN3 quality-gap and VAE fur-texture explanation, days-long training limitation, and full-body failure discussion.

D1.justification: v2 supplies embedding-initialization budgets, editing settings, and implementation details for Zero-1-to-3 and SDS refinement. Appendix C.2 newly clarifies that its DreamBooth implementation omits class-specific prior preservation loss. v1 promises a future code release; v2 states that code is available under a renamed project. Some earlier reproducibility information, including the explicit torchmetrics FID implementation reference, is removed.

R1.justification: Positioning shifts toward image-only alternatives to task-specific, labeled-data generation, adding discussion and citations for pix2pix, InterfaceGAN, Text2Shape, ShapeCrafter, SDEdit, Zero-1-to-3, and DreamFusion. The earlier guidance-related-work subsection and the Du et al. and Liu et al. compositional-generation citations are removed. Publication updates to retained references are not counted as new works.

P1.justification: The title, abstract, introduction, contribution list, and substantial portions of the narrative are rewritten. The separate task-analysis and GCFG-exploration structure becomes a mechanism, learning, and application-pipeline structure, with reorganized experiments and appendices. Concept/domain and DreamBooth/Fine-tuning terminology changes accompany this extensive restructuring.

P2.justification: v2 redraws overview and mechanism diagrams, adds domain-alignment, editing, and 3D displays, and merges v1 Tables 1–2 into a wider table with new rows and columns. It corrects the spatial-alignment direction arrow. Several existing figures are relocated or combined: v1 Figure 10 becomes part of v2 Figure 12, and the unchanged benchmark galleries become Figures 16, 17, and 19.

improvement.justification: Testing LoRA addresses v1's decision to exclude it based on parameter count, while porcelain, editing, and 3D experiments better support the claimed applicability. Condition-conflict analysis and quantified resource costs improve practical assessment. These gains are moderated by removal of the StyleGAN3 quality reference and guidance-sensitivity evidence, and the new initialization's benefit is not isolated experimentally. The evidence supports a limited net improvement.
